name: U.S. Senate Page Program
what_you_do: You get a paid job on the Senate floor. You also work in offices. You attend the Senate Page School for one semester or the summer.
who_can_apply: US citizen (the Senate application guide also mentions permanent residents; ask the office) with a Social Security number. Must be 16 or 17 at appointment, a junior (semester) or rising junior or senior (summer), with a 3.0 GPA and health forms. Needs a Senator's sponsorship. Senator Padilla sponsors California residents only.
duration: Spring 2027 session: Jan 24 to June 4, 2027. Summer 2027 dates to be announced.
deadline_text: Padilla's office: opens Oct 13, 2026, closes Oct 26, 2026 for the Spring 2027 session.
how_to_apply: Send a cover letter, resume, recent transcript and two recommendation letters to Senator Padilla's office at Page_Program@padilla.senate.gov. Other Senate offices have their own rules; the central Page Program does not take applications.
notes: Only about 30 positions in the whole Senate. Pages pay their own travel to and from Washington, DC. The job is in DC, so a California work permit likely does not apply; ask the office. Moving to DC for a semester is a big step for a family.
